title: Mezzrow tour personnel and Jazz Limited
summary: Moore moved between Chicago and Paris tours with Archey, Pops Foster and Lee Collins who fell ill.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well, when you got back from the Mezzrow tour... Did you stay with Mezzrow for a while before you went over with Sammy Price?
No, after I finished... I don't think I did anything. I think I did go back to... After Mezzrow I went back to Jazz Limited.
So you were sort of based in Chicago during this time, even though you would come back to New York.
Or you just happened to be in Chicago for a while?
Well, when I went to Jazz Limited the first time, that's when Sammy Price contacted me. I think we had one or two rehearsals here. We had Jimmy Archey, myself, Pops Foster, Mezzrow, Lee Collins...
Yeah, but he couldn't... I don't think he could make it. He taken sick, you know. Lungs.
Well, it's possible that Collins went over but had to come back...
